overview: Build a Flutter mobile client and a Rust+Tauri desktop agent that connect directly (no server in v1) to run API calls, terminal commands, and VNC-based UI checks from a timeline-centric workflow.
goals: Enable mobile-first verification workflows via timeline, command bar, API explorer, terminal, and VNC viewer
Provide a secure pairing and direct connection between mobile and desktop agent using cloudflared
Keep all session data local with optional export/import
nonGoals: No central server, accounts, or multi-device cloud sync in v1
No full desktop-grade code editing on mobile
No offline execution of remote actions
successMetrics: Pairing completes in under 2 minutes for first-time users
Users complete at least one verification action per session
VNC usage remains under 20% of total actions to indicate verification-first design
openQuestions: Cloudflared tunnel limits and latency impact on VNC streaming
Fallback behavior when cloudflared is unavailable or blocked
Security posture for shared secrets at rest on mobile and desktop

uiNotes: Timeline is the primary navigation surface; tapping events restores tool context
Command Bar is the single entry point for intent parsing and action routing
API Explorer uses structured JSON tree views with response diffs and error highlights
Terminal supports multiple sessions with quick controls (Ctrl+C, history, presets)
VNC viewer optimized for short verification with trackpad mode and zoom bar

importFormat.description: Export/import bundle for local-only data migration between devices.

rules: All actions are executed on the paired desktop agent and recorded locally on mobile
Pairing requires a short-lived token and a shared secret confirmation
Timeline events are append-only and ordered by creation time
Cloudflared tunnel is required for connections outside local network
If connection drops, actions are blocked and surfaced with recovery UI

stories.title: Scaffold Flutter mobile app and Rust/Tauri desktop agent
stories.description: As a developer, I want a clean project scaffold for both clients so local development is possible.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Flutter mobile app scaffold and Rust/Tauri desktop agent scaffold
Document dependency installs with explicit commands (example: `flutter pub add <pkg>` and `cargo add <crate>`)
Add scripts for `flutter test` and `flutter analyze`
Example: running `flutter test` passes a baseline test
Negative case: missing required dependency fails `flutter analyze` with a clear error

stories.title: Desktop agent command channel and protocol
stories.description: As a user, I want the desktop agent to accept commands from mobile and return results.
acceptanceCriteria: Define a message schema for request/response and error payloads
Expose a local command handler in the agent for API, terminal, and VNC actions
Example: mobile sends a ping command and receives a structured pong response
Negative case: unknown command returns a standardized error payload

stories.title: Pairing flow with QR token and shared secret
stories.description: As a user, I want to pair my mobile app with my desktop agent securely.
acceptanceCriteria: Desktop agent generates a short-lived pairing token and QR code
Mobile scans QR and confirms a shared secret before saving the connection
Example: valid token + correct secret results in a connected state
Negative case: expired token is rejected with a retry prompt

stories.title: Cloudflared tunnel integration
stories.description: As a user, I want mobile and desktop to connect over the internet via a tunnel.
acceptanceCriteria: Desktop agent starts a cloudflared tunnel and exposes a connection URL
Mobile stores the tunnel URL as part of the connection record
Example: remote connection succeeds when mobile is off the local network
Negative case: tunnel startup failure is shown with a clear remediation message

stories.title: Local data storage for sessions and events
stories.description: As a user, I want my timeline and tool history stored locally on mobile.
acceptanceCriteria: Persist core entities in local storage with a defined schema
Install storage dependencies with explicit commands (example: `flutter pub add sqflite` and `flutter pub add flutter_secure_storage`)
Example: timeline events persist after app restart
Negative case: storage initialization failure shows a blocking error state

stories.title: Timeline UI with context restore
stories.description: As a user, I want a timeline of verification events and quick return to context.
acceptanceCriteria: Timeline list displays event type, title, and timestamp
Tapping an API event routes to API Explorer with request/response loaded
Example: tapping a terminal event opens the referenced session
Negative case: event references missing context shows a clear error state

stories.title: Command Bar intent parsing and routing
stories.description: As a user, I want a single command bar to trigger API, terminal, AI, or VNC actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Command input accepts natural language and structured commands
Route recognized intents to the correct tool and create a timeline event
Example: `POST /login` opens API Explorer with method and URL prefilled
Negative case: ambiguous command prompts the user to choose a tool

stories.title: API Explorer via desktop agent
stories.description: As a user, I want to run API requests on the desktop agent and inspect structured responses on mobile.
acceptanceCriteria: Send API request details to the agent and receive structured response payload
Render response status, latency, headers, and JSON tree on mobile
Example: response diff highlights changed fields from previous run
Negative case: invalid JSON body prevents request with validation message

stories.title: Multi-session terminal streaming
stories.description: As a user, I want multiple terminal sessions that stream stdout and stderr.
acceptanceCriteria: Create, switch, and close terminal sessions
Separate stdout and stderr streams in the UI
Example: run `npm test` and see stdout/stderr separated
Negative case: session disconnect shows a reconnect prompt

stories.title: VNC viewer for quick UI verification
stories.description: As a user, I want a VNC viewer optimized for short verification tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement trackpad mode for pointer control and gestures
Provide zoom bar with center-on-pointer behavior
Example: open VNC from timeline event and exit with swipe down
Negative case: VNC stream failure shows a clear recovery action

stories.title: Export and import local data
stories.description: As a user, I want to export local data and import it on another device.
acceptanceCriteria: Export produces a versioned JSON bundle of connections and timeline events
Import validates bundle version and merges data
Example: importing a bundle restores timeline history
Negative case: invalid bundle schema is rejected with a clear error

stories.title: AI insight summaries for errors
stories.description: As a user, I want AI-generated insights on errors to speed up verification.
acceptanceCriteria: Trigger AI analysis for API and terminal errors
Display AI summary in timeline and tool context
Example: missing field error highlights the missing key
Negative case: AI service unavailable shows a fallback message without blocking
